subject: SEC: announceMilestone posts client-supplied free text to public Discord (twin of 369)
description:
Found by Nancy 2026-09-08 while reviewing 369; I verified the source. functions/index.js ~9790 exports.announceMilestone takes { type, name, score } straight from request.data and interpolates name and score directly into a Discord embed posted to the PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENTS_CHANNEL, with no verification that the quiz/course/certification was ever completed. Same channel, same bot token, same discordId + milestoneAnnouncements opt-in gate as announceAchievement (369), but with NO rarity gate and no proof-store option even in principle, because it is designed around quiz/course CLAIMS rather than badge PROOF. ZERO callers in _app, verified - dead from the UI, live as a callable any linked+opted-in account can hit directly. Tracked separately so the pair is not fixed by halves, but the DECISION is joint with 369: retire both, archive first, per the BUG-237b updateStreak precedent. Do not harden one without the other.
[2026-09-08 22:42] DELETED FROM PRODUCTION + verified 2026-09-08, jointly with 369 - the pair was retired together so neither half was left live. Same evidence: 0 invocations in 30d, 0 callers, 0 Firestore writes, 0 linked Discord accounts, 0 users opted in to milestoneAnnouncements. Archived source + redacted deployed config before deletion.
